start.title: [TODO:ar] The King's Messengers
start.text:
[TODO:ar] Moab's envoys arrive with gold.
"Curse Israel for our king."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Accept the gold without asking
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Silver dazzles; God is silent.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Send them away with a vague vow
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Half-hearted answers serve no one.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask the Lord what to say
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow to seek His voice.

greed_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Gold Cannot Buy His Word
greed_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His mouth is not for sale.
Kneel and ask Him first.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask the Lord what to say
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Silence falls in your tent.

vague_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Speak Plainly Before Him
vague_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Half-truths help no man.
Go to the Lord directly.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask the Lord what to say
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You wait on His answer.

first_word.title: [TODO:ar] "Do Not Go"
first_word.text:
[TODO:ar] The Lord says, "Bless, do not curse."
The envoys ride home empty.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Send messengers chasing the king's gold
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your heart already drifts.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Tell new envoys what God said
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Truth, not silver, on your tongue.

chase_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Stay Where He Set You
chase_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Wages cannot weigh against His word.
Wait for His messengers instead.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Tell new envoys what God said
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You speak only what was given.

second_offer.title: [TODO:ar] Princes at Your Door
second_offer.text:
[TODO:ar] Greater nobles come, greater gold.
"Name your price," they say.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pretend you never heard the first word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His word does not unsay itself.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse, even for a house of silver
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You speak the words plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Demand a higher fee in secret
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Greed is a louder god than truth.

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] His Word Stands
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] You cannot bury what He spoke.
Answer with truth.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse, even for a house of silver
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The princes hear you firmly.

fee_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] No Price for Prophecy
fee_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His mouth is not a marketplace.
Let your refusal be plain.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse, even for a house of silver
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Their faces darken at your word.

saddle_donkey.title: [TODO:ar] Yet You Saddle the Donkey
saddle_donkey.text:
[TODO:ar] Their gold still glitters in your mind.
You ride toward Moab anyway.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Turn back and stay in your tent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Wisdom keeps you home.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Press on, planning what to say
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The road grows uneasy.

narrow_path.title: [TODO:ar] The Donkey Stops
narrow_path.text:
[TODO:ar] She bolts into a field.
You see only stubborn beast.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Beat her back onto the road
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You strike what you cannot see.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pause and ask why she fears
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Her eye sees what yours cannot.

humbled_early.title: [TODO:ar] A Glimpse of Light
humbled_early.text:
[TODO:ar] The road shimmers with hidden warning.
Fear of God softens your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Continue with humility
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your eyes will soon be opened.

second_block.title: [TODO:ar] Crushed Against the Wall
second_block.text:
[TODO:ar] She presses your foot to the stone.
Pain blinds you further.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Curse her and beat her again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your anger grows; your sight does not.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stop and listen to the silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Something stands ahead unseen.

third_block.title: [TODO:ar] She Lies Down Beneath You
third_block.text:
[TODO:ar] The donkey will not rise.
Then her mouth opens.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Strike her one more time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Hardness will not save you now.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hear her words in fear
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "What have I done to you?"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Laugh and call it madness
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Mockery cannot dim the truth.

strike_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Your Hand Falls Empty
strike_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Three times you have struck her.
Now listen to what she says.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hear her words in fear
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your staff lowers slowly.

laugh_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] This Is No Madness
laugh_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The Lord opened her mouth.
Close your own and listen.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hear her words in fear
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The laughter dies on your lips.

angel_revealed.title: [TODO:ar] Your Eyes Are Opened
angel_revealed.text:
[TODO:ar] An angel stands, sword drawn.
"Your way is perverse before Me."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Defend yourself with proud excuses
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Truth needs no defense from you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow your face to the dust
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "I have sinned. I did not see."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Beg him for the king's gold instead
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Even now your heart is divided.

defend_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Lower Your Pride
defend_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His sword shines truer than your words.
Kneel and confess.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow your face to the dust
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You sink to the rocky ground.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Let Go of the Gold
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Silver cannot stand before His blade.
Repent before you speak again.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow your face to the dust
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your hands open and empty.

ending_obedient.title: [TODO:ar] The Tent at Dawn
ending_obedient.text:
[TODO:ar] You stayed where He set you.
No blade. No blindness. Only peace.

ending_humbled.title: [TODO:ar] "Speak Only What I Tell You"
ending_humbled.text:
[TODO:ar] The angel sheathes his sword.
You ride on, His word in your mouth.
